hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its high-stakes economic framing, moral panic over austerity, and intra-party power struggles that mirror broader ideological battles in Latin America.

hotspots.title: Trump administration pushes governmentwide NDA
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration’s proposal to mandate nondisclosure agreements (NDAs) for federal employees has sparked outrage, with critics framing it as an authoritarian overreach to suppress leaks and dissent. Coverage highlights legal challenges, bipartisan opposition, and comparisons to historical censorship.
hotspots.affect: This story dominates due to its perceived threat to democratic norms, with intense framing around secrecy, authoritarianism, and the erosion of transparency in government.

hotspots.title: AfD’s rise and mainstream party responses in Germany
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) continues to surge in polls, particularly in eastern Germany, prompting debates over mainstream parties’ strategies to counter its influence. Coverage focuses on CDU/SPD efforts to exclude AfD from leadership roles, legal challenges to its extremism, and public protests against its policies.
hotspots.affect: This commands high affective investment due to fears of far-right normalization, democratic backsliding, and the moral panic over immigration and nationalism.
affect_signals: cross-source repetition of AfD’s electoral gains

hotspots.title: Threats against Erika Kirk and Turning Point USA
hotspots.blurb: A Texas man was arrested for allegedly threatening to bomb and kill Erika Kirk, CEO of Turning Point USA, ahead of a conservative summit. Coverage emphasizes the escalating violence against right-wing figures, the role of online radicalization, and the broader climate of political intimidation.
hotspots.affect: This story commands high affective investment due to its alarmist framing around political violence, moral panic over extremism, and the perceived targeting of conservative leaders.
